NZ Clean Car Programme (CCP) scheme
This information is provided is an estimated guide on what Clean Car Standard (CSS) fee or debit will be.
The information is provided "as is". There are no warranties or guarantees, express or implied, relating to the CCS data provided. Many factors can influence the final figure, such as engine type, chassis model, fuel, vehicle dimensions, weight etc and due to limitations of available data at time of auction this should only be used as an estimated guide and amount could change at time of registration.
The lower the emissions - the higher the credit, the higher the emissions - the higher the fee. The fees and debits in this notice are estimates.

Visit https://dealer.rightcar.govt.nz/ or NZ Clean Car Standard websites for more information.
